source: OpenStreetMap Wiki: Davao City/Public transportation (jeepney tables)
note: Only downtown (Poblacion) routes are documented. Davao's many named routes to Toril, Mintal, Calinan, Bangkal, Buhangin, Panacan, and elsewhere are not covered yet. Street lists are 'via' lists, so turns between them are estimated.
